Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class PlantSharedResourceEvidence

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.PlantSharedResourceEvidence
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class PlantSharedResourceEvidence extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable participant-complete evidence for one maximum shared-resource budget.

This evidence is captured only from caller-owned completed state. It retains no process, bus, equipment, callback, or supplier reference. Missing, unexpected, stale, non-finite, metadata-inconsistent, or unconverged observations fail closed. Aggregation uses only the explicit participant conversions registered in the matching PlantConstraintDefinition; unlike units or bases are never inferred.

    • fromProcessSystemShaftPower

      public static PlantSharedResourceEvidence fromProcessSystemShaftPower(PlantConstraintDefinition definition, String calculationId, double applicableLimit, ProcessSystem process, boolean convergenceComplete, String provenance)
      Captures exact top-level compressor and pump shaft-power participants from a solved process system.
      Parameters:
      definition - shared-budget registration whose participants are equipment names
      calculationId - exact completed calculation identity
      applicableLimit - finite positive shared limit in the definition unit and basis
      process - solved isolated process system
      convergenceComplete - caller's full-candidate convergence decision
      provenance - runtime evidence provenance
      Returns:
      immutable callback-free evidence

    • fromProcessSystemShaftPower

      public static PlantSharedResourceEvidence fromProcessSystemShaftPower(PlantConstraintDefinition definition, String calculationId, double applicableLimit, ProcessSystem process, boolean convergenceComplete, String provenance, Collection<String> outOfServiceParticipantIds)
      Captures shaft-power evidence with explicit out-of-service equipment identities.

      An out-of-service declaration is accepted only when the solved equipment power is numerically zero. It never converts a missing or non-zero observation to zero.

      Parameters:
      definition - shared-budget registration whose participants are equipment names
      calculationId - exact completed calculation identity
      applicableLimit - finite positive shared limit
      process - solved isolated process system
      convergenceComplete - caller's full-candidate convergence decision
      provenance - runtime evidence provenance
      outOfServiceParticipantIds - equipment names explicitly unavailable in this line-up
      Returns:
      immutable callback-free evidence

    • fromSolvedEnergyBusRequestedDemand

      public static PlantSharedResourceEvidence fromSolvedEnergyBusRequestedDemand(PlantConstraintDefinition definition, String calculationId, double applicableLimit, EnergyBus bus, String provenance)
      Captures requested electrical demand from a current solved energy-bus report.

      The aggregate is requested demand, not served demand, so unmet load remains visible. Every input port must be registered as a constraint participant. External bus demand and bidirectional demand fail closed because neither has an unambiguous participant contract.

      Parameters:
      definition - electrical shared-budget registration using stable energy-port participant IDs
      calculationId - exact completed calculation identity
      applicableLimit - finite positive electrical limit
      bus - solved isolated electrical energy bus
      provenance - runtime evidence provenance
      Returns:
      immutable callback-free evidence
